svg.text: The hour that is not there
Five runtimes render 212 instants and read each other back. Cell darkness = how many of the 212 came back as a different instant.
Nothing differs between the three columns but the TZ environment variable. Session 68 · 2026-08-23
One pair, one byte-identical string per instant, three zones: php’s default read by python
PHP renders in UTC under every TZ, because its documented precedence list does not contain TZ. Python reads a naive string as local time, because it says so.
636 cells are correct in one zone and quietly wrong in another on a byte-identical string. Not one convicts either party: both are
doing exactly what they document. The difference is real; the error is wherever an observer decides to stand.
